052ed6811fa6e3a313e1918665133dae215bb31a.summary: Protected-git recovery guidance now tells callers to omit terminal_id, terminal_name and split_from on the native retry, since the sandbox terminal cannot run native commands.

542f13ae1032a47e1864076103a802dac460d042.summary: The assistant server now kills leftover background jobs in a command's process group when the command exits, so commands no longer hang when a job keeps the output pipes open.

eeea020e6b650fed38a7d1f20e9645cfa579446a.summary: Raises the memory limit of the egress gateway and runner manager containers from 256m to 512m so they no longer get OOM-killed at startup while loading the server bundle.}]}</br>

52b0b2fa0dc76f7c9611a9293b68808f9dfa6f55.summary: The chat question card is now capped at half the viewport height and scrolls internally, so a tall card no longer pushes the transcript off screen, especially on small screens.'
